text_block_list.name: False-Eyelash Gal
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Boss.
Ain't next week's shift schedule messed up?

text_block_list.name: Convenience Store Manager
text_block_list.text:
Huh? It's right though~
I double-checked it tons of times!

text_block_list.name: Part-Time Gal
text_block_list.text:
No, no, there's gotta be a mistake.
Ines's shifts increased like crazy.

text_block_list.name: Convenience Store Manager
text_block_list.text:
...Hmm~? No, it's definitely right.
We're on an irregular shift this month.

Summer training camp starts today!
I was on the bus, swaying along with
Ines Fujin as we headed to the special facility.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
*yaaawn*... Mornin' mornin'~...
It's so bright outside...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Howevvver, that deep sleep totally recharged me!
Alrighty, let's get fired up and go, go, go!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
choice_data_list: What's with all that heavy luggage?!
What's with all that heavy luggage?!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Ah, this? It's piecework.
There aren't many part-time gigs you can fit in during a training camp, right?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I took on something new.
I really wanted to increase my earnings, even just a little!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
It's actually not bad, you know? You can do it whenever you have spare time.
Trainer, if you find yourself with some free time, lend a hand!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Whoops, personal stuff aside—let's talk training!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"We made a new resolution to master an efficient running style, right?
It'll be a hassle going forward if you keep collapsing every single time."

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
You've been brainstorming too, right, Trainer?
A way for Ines to become super energy-efficient with top-tier fuel economy!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Yay! Don't slack off on training either, okay? Looking forward to working with you during summer camp~!
And so, summer training camp kicked off.
